title: Coordinated launch priority lanes and capacity guardrails for runtime/console/api
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Create a coordinated launch framework that defines priority lanes (Critical, High, Routine) across Runtime, Console, and API surfaces, plus explicit capacity guardrails and escalation paths. This ticket delivers: 1) a priority-lane matrix tying features to launch cohorts and SLOs; 2) a capacity reservation and burst policy for Dedicated pools during critical launches; 3) a cross-team dependency board to visualize sequencing and hard/soft blockers; 4) a playbook for cutover, rollback, and post-launch telemetry checks. Scope: runtime serving changes that affect throughput or kernel selection, Console deploy windows and observability dashboards, and API contract/version gating. Out of scope: long-term quota redesign and billing model changes. Acceptance criteria: - Priority-lane matrix reviewed and approved by Runtime, Console, and API leads. - Capacity guardrail config (min-reserve, burst-cap, fallback models) documented and simulated in staging. - Dependency board populated with owners and dates for all items required for the April release window. - Cutover playbook validated with one runbook drill during Cycle 2026-W11. Stakeholders: PM (Aisha Patel), Release Manager (Marco Li), Eng leads: Runtime (Ibrahim Khan), Console (Sofia Romero), API (Ethan Zhao), Design (Mira Chen), SRE (Priya Rao). Success metrics: percentage of launches using the matrix; number of unexpected capacity shortages during launch (target 0); mean time to rollback (target < 10 minutes for tier-Critical). Risks: inaccurate traffic forecasts, late upstream PR merges, cross-team misalignment on model fallbacks. Mitigations: require traffic forecast 10 days prior, gating PRs via release checklist, automated smoke tests and failover routes configured. Operational hooks: add a "launch-lane" tag to telemetry, precreate Grafana dashboard with token-level cost and latency, and configure PagerDuty escalation for capacity breaches. Communication: weekly triage sync until cutover, then daily check-ins 3 days pre-launch. Deliverables: priority matrix doc, capacity config JSON, dependency board link, cutover playbook, verified staging drill log.
